data.question: I read the free series. Is the book worth it?
data.answer: All the text is free on my blog, as a series. The book is the same text assembled into one book, available today, plus a foreword, a "Try this" exercise in every chapter, the merged FAQ (38 questions), the cheat sheet appendix, and an offline PDF and EPUB. The **Complete** edition adds the Starter Pack and the worksheets. If the series gave you what you needed, you don't need the book. I mean it.

data.question: What is the difference between Book and Complete?
data.answer: **Complete** is the book plus the **Findability Starter Pack** (5 note templates, 6 Bases, 35 saved searches, `ripgrep` and `fzf` scripts, a `qmd` configuration and an `AGENTS.md` snippet; a small starter set, not the Obsidian Starter Kit) and the **6 worksheets** (20-query test, 30-day makeover tracker, LATCH audit, capture-time checklist, search log and resurfacing routine), for €20 more. Both include the PDF, the EPUB and the free updates.

data.question: Which formats do I get?
data.answer: PDF and EPUB, so you can read it on a computer, a tablet or an e-reader.

data.question: Do I need the Obsidian Starter Kit?
data.answer: No. The book works with any vault. That being said, if you'd rather start from a finished system, the [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit) ships the note types, templates, properties and Bases the book describes.

data.question: Do I need AI tools?
data.answer: No. Two chapters cover AI search. The rest of the book works without it.

data.question: How do updates work?
data.answer: Updates are free for the whole 2026 edition (all 1.x versions); the book is written and checked against Obsidian 1.14. New versions appear in your Gumroad library.

data.question: Is there a free sample?
data.answer: Yes. The [Free Obsidian Search Cheat Sheet](/product/obsidian-search-cheat-sheet) is a short reference with the search escalation ladder.

data.question: Is there a discount?
data.answer: The Complete edition is included in the [Everything Knowledge Bundle](/product/everything-knowledge-bundle).

data.question: What if it's not for me? Can I get a refund?
data.answer: Yes. There's a 30-day money-back guarantee: reply to your receipt email within 30 days and I'll refund you, no hard feelings.

data.question: Is VAT included?
data.answer: Prices are shown before VAT; EU VAT is added at checkout based on your country.
